item.title: Paul Reed Smith joined a long list of music industry icons this weekend after he was inducted into the Guitar Center Rockwalk during Eric Clapton's Cr...
item.description:
Paul Reed Smith joined a long list of music industry icons this weekend after he was inducted into the Guitar Center Rockwalk during Eric Clapton's Crossroads Music Festival! Soon the tile displaying his name, induction year, and hand prints will be displayed outside Guitar Center's flagship store in Hollywood for all to see.

Join us in congratulating our fearless leader! Well deserved, Paul.

item.title: Introducing the @prsguitars Silver Sky @defender Color Collection: core models in four classic vintage Land Rover Defender colors, limited to 500 each...
item.description: Introducing the @prsguitars Silver Sky @defender Color Collection: core models in four classic vintage Land Rover Defender colors, limited to 500 each. Four SE models in contemporary colors will be available for a limited time. This has been a dream of mine going back many years, since picking up my ‘97 Arles Blue D90 and envisioning a guitar in that color. Partnering with @defender to make it an even more vivid reality has been one of my favorite projects in a long time. Head to prsguitars.com for more.
